name: Ship-hull beach bar (shark/ship bar building + counters + stool + service table)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint (ship-bar building's top-left corner); origin snapped to (240,128) on the 21_Beach sheet. Height is 11, not 10: drinks_topper (dy=10, one tile tall) sits one row below the service_table/guest_chair row.

offset_basis_summary: The ship-bar building, its two counter modules, the guest chair and the service table are all laid out contiguously in the same sheet region (x240-352, y128-288 on 21_Beach), so their offsets are read directly from sheet_x/sheet_y (sheet_relative). The chair_2 exs reports sheet_x=239 (1px off chair_1's 240) which is a vision-labeling rounding artifact for the same tile cell.

pieces.notes: Pre-composed ship/shark hull bar building; already spans 7x5 tiles by itself.
Bottle decor sprite sits one row below the table on the sheet (fractional cocktail/glass variants share the same cell); placed by hand on the service table.

variants.chair_count: guest_chair is optional; add a second chair mirrored on counter_right for two-seat service.
variants.drinks_topper: Swap the bottle for cocktail_1_table / cocktail_2_table / glass_table exs for a different tabletop prop.

notes: The ship-bar building is already multi_tile on its own; this grp widens it into a working bar counter with seating so the counters/chair/table land on the correct sand-front side of the hull rather than stacked on top of it.
